findings.description: The elm site only subscribes to the 'reports' queue. Routing new deliveries to 'report-dispatch' means 8 jobs due in the observation window will have no consumer at elm and sit undelivered.
findings.reasoning: Review identifies that elm only subscribes to 'reports', notes the 8 jobs due in the window would be stranded, and correctly distinguishes new vs existing jobs.

findings.description: Cedar subscribes to both queues and would handle the routing change.
findings.reasoning: Review notes cedar subscribes to both queues and would handle the change.
